layouts.name: Scrapbook (custom)
layouts.desc: A developer-authored layout: the scene matted like a photo on a warm scrapbook page, the line in a caption card accented with the speaker's colour.

meta.description: A short sample that exercises every GVNF v1.0 feature: layered sprites, expression & outfit changes, the two-character stage rule with three-way alternating dialogue, transitions, an item close-up, a CG, a branching choice, variables, localization (en/ja), and two endings.
